name: token-optimizer-hooks-only
display_name: Token Optimizer (hooks only, no MCP server)
install_doc: THE SCHEMA-TAX ARM. Byte-identical to the token-optimizer-mcp manifest -- same pinned 6.0.2 runtime, same five hooks, same env -- with the entire "mcp" block removed, so no MCP server is registered and none of its 19 tool schemas (26,286 bytes, ~7,300 tokens measured via tools/list) enter the request. Comparing this arm against token-optimizer-mcp isolates the cost of ADVERTISING the tools, which the existing token-optimizer-mcp-off arm deliberately does not: that one sets TOKEN_OPTIMIZER_MODE=off to isolate enforcement and keeps the schemas present on both sides. Verified before running that the hooks degrade correctly with no server: `npm test` is still bounded, and the router stops naming smart_* tools because it requires positive runtime inventory evidence before recommending one -- so this arm never advises a tool that does not exist. It does lose the recursive-search bound, which only fires behind a verdict.
